title: TickPulse API
description: HTTP API RED metrics per route, status codes, JSON vs XML content negotiation and rate limiting.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: HTTP requests per second, selected routes.

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status. Alert threshold: 2 %.

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: Server-side request duration, 95th percentile.

panels.title: XML share
panels.description: Share of analytics responses negotiated as XML (Accept: application/xml).

panels.title: Rate-limited
panels.description: Requests rejected with 429 in the selected time range.

panels.title: In-flight
panels.description: Requests currently being processed.

panels.title: Request rate by route
panels.description: Requests per second for each route template.

panels.title: 5xx ratio by route
panels.description: Share of 5xx responses per route. The dashed line is the 2 % alert threshold.

targets.expr: (sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="tickpulse-api", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="tickpulse-api", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="tickpulse-api", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Server-side request duration across the selected routes.

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: Per-route summary over the selected time range.

targets.expr: (sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="tickpulse-api", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="tickpulse-api", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))) / sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="tickpulse-api", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

panels.title: p95 latency by route
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration per route.

panels.title: Responses by status
panels.description: Analytics responses per second by HTTP status.

panels.title: JSON vs XML
panels.description: Negotiated response content type in the selected time range.

panels.title: Content type over time
panels.description: JSON vs XML as a share of all responses.

panels.title: Status codes
panels.description: Responses per status code in the selected time range.

panels.title: Responses by route and content type
panels.description: Which routes are asked for JSON and which for XML.

panels.title: Rejected requests
panels.description: 429 responses per route, plus limiter rejections by policy when the ASP.NET Core rate-limiting meter is exported.

panels.title: Rejection ratio
panels.description: Share of requests rejected with 429 in the selected time range.

panels.title: Slow requests
